numinance.kinds.v1.AutonomyMatch.jsonsch.description:
AutonomyMatch selects changes; an absent key matches every value and an empty match matches every change. In a
 rule, risk matches exactly and a key the change has no value for does not match. In a floor, risk matches that
 class and every higher one, and a key the change has no value for counts as a match.

environment.description: environment is the name of the environment the change acts in.

playbook.description: playbook is the name of the change's playbook.

risk.description: risk is the change's risk class, fixed at Classified.
risk.title: Risk Class
